relationships.subject: PDIA3
relationships.evidence_quote: protein disulfide isomerase A3 (PDIA3) catalyzes HMGB1 oxidation to ds-HMGB1 via Cys23-Cys45 bond formation

relationships.subject: GSDMD
relationships.evidence_quote: gasdermin D (GSDMD)-mediated pyroptosis drives its release

relationships.subject: ds-HMGB1
relationships.evidence_quote: Released ds-HMGB1 engages Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4) on C2-subtype sensory neurons

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: triggering nuclear factor κB (NF-κB)-dependent upregulation of transient receptor potential vanilloid 1 (TRPV1) and amplifying mechanical allodynia

key_findings: ds-HMGB1 from DRG macrophages released via GSDMD pyroptosis drives oxaliplatin neuropathic pain via TLR4/NF-κB/TRPV1 on C2 neurons.
PDIA3, GSDMD or ds-HMGB1 inhibition alleviates pain; serum ds-HMGB1 correlates with pain severity.
